name: Corporate Espionage Alibi Verification
task:
Please complete the following four-stage alibi verification task in order.

=== Stage 1: Suspect Timeline Extraction ===
Four employees are suspected of leaking confidential files from TechCorp on Friday night:
- Employee A (Sarah): Claims she left at 6pm, had dinner at a restaurant (receipt: 7:15pm), then went to a movie (ticket: 8:30pm-10:45pm)
- Employee B (James): Claims he was working late until 9pm, then went straight home. Building access log shows his badge at 6pm, 7:30pm, and 9:05pm.
- Employee C (Maria): Claims she was at a networking event from 6pm-11pm. Event photos show her at 7pm and 9pm but not between 8pm-8:45pm.
- Employee D (Tom): Claims he was at his desk from 5pm-10pm. Badge log shows entries at 5pm, 6:15pm, and a suspicious exit at 8:20pm with re-entry at 9:40pm.
The files were accessed from an internal terminal at 8:35pm and transferred to an external drive at 8:42pm. Extract each employee's timeline.

=== Stage 2: Evidence Cross-Comparison ===
Cross-reference each timeline against:
- Server logs: terminal access at 8:35pm from IP assigned to the 3rd floor (where B, C, and D work)
- Security footage: person in hoodie (unidentifiable) at 3rd floor elevator at 8:30pm and 9:35pm
- Building access: external door opened at 8:20pm and 9:40pm (matches D's badge)
- Email logs: the leaked files were sent from an anonymous email at 9:15pm
Identify all contradictions.

=== Stage 3: Contradiction Resolution ===
Resolve contradictions by priority: server logs > security footage > badge records > verbal claims. Electronic timestamps are authoritative. Adjust timelines and identify viable alibis.

=== Stage 4: Final Determination ===
Determine which employee(s) could have accessed and leaked the files. Identify verified alibis. If multiple suspects, rank by likelihood. Note any potential collusion.

subtasks.name: Timeline contradiction resolution and consistency adjustment
